# Three.js

Three.js r179, copied from this repository's `games/hide-and-seek/vendor/` with user approval for the Illuminauts 3D migration. `three.module.js` imports the adjacent `three.core.js`. Both files are unmodified. License: `THREE-LICENSE.txt` (MIT).

These local files replace the reference prototype's CDN import. No runtime network fetch or package install is required for the 3D engine.
